title: Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Network Optimization and Edge Intelligent Detection for Transmission Line Insulator
description: This record contains the dataset, YOLO annotations, data split scripts, source code, model configuration, evaluation scripts and edge deployment scripts for the paper 'Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Network Optimization and Edge Intelligent Detection for Transmission Line Insulator'. The proposed model TBAM-YOLOv8-EMSFFN integrates a Three-Branch Attention Mechanism (TBAM) and an Enhanced Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Network (EMSFFN) into a lightweight YOLOv8 framework for transmission line insulator defect detection. The dataset includes normal insulators, self-explosion defects, breakage defects and flashover defects. The code supports training, validation, five-fold cross-validation, unseen-line generalization testing, cross-dataset testing and NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX edge deployment with TensorRT FP16.
